_uitleg: Reviews en scores voor de site. De n8n-flow "Site: reviews bijwerken" werkt op de laatste dag van de maand de scores bij en voegt nieuwe reviews toe (minimaal 4 sterren, niet op de uitsluitlijst). Handmatig mag je branche, bedrijf, foto, link, vertaling en de volgorde aanpassen; die laat de flow staan. De lijst gezien bevat elke review die al beoordeeld is (getoond of bewust niet); alleen reviews die daar niet in staan voegt de flow toe, en daarna zet hij ze in gezien.

reviews.tekst: Kyle was extremely fast, efficient, accurate and personable. I am extremely happy with his service and would recommend him for others needing an opening balance sheet for their DAFT businesses.
Very happy with the quick and precise services provided by Slim Geregeld in regards to establishing opening balances for my DAFT visa. Highly recommend Kyle's bookkeeping services in any regards!
I contacted Kyle with a tax recovery project. He was constructive, responsive, he worked extensively and delivered beyond expectations. I warmly recommend him!

From the very beginning, he took the time to clearly explain the services he offered, the process involved, and the fee structure, which made me feel confident and comfortable throughout the entire process. His work was consistently thorough and handled with great care and attention to detail. What particularly stood out to me was his transparency regarding any additional services and associated costs. He also respected my decision to handle certain tasks myself, rather than making me feel pressured to use additional paid services. It was clear that his priority was not simply to provide a service, but to understand my needs and find the most suitable way to support me. His professionalism, attention to detail, transparency, and flexibility made the entire experience very positive. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and considerate bookkeeper.
